correctness.rationale: The all-characteristic proof reconstructs the unique automorphism parameterization, performs a recursive conjugation by units in a truncated polynomial ring (nonresonant terms invert because a^j!=1), proves uniqueness via cyclic norm and coprime-power bijection, computes stabilizer size and uniform resonant coefficients, and reduces fixed-space kernels to multiplication by H(z)-1 on one truncated residue-class summand. The event counts sum to the full automorphism group size. Standalone direct finite-field matrix enumerations for 13 (q,n) cases and explicit normal-form checks in four cases all returned VERIFY_OK. These finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The exact fixed-subspace spectrum is a natural invariant of the finite automorphism action on the unique maximal-nilindex Leibniz algebra in each dimension. Its characteristic-uniform cyclotomic threshold, canonical unipotent-conjugacy normal form and equal orbit sizes classify the source of all rank drops; Burnside then yields orbit counts of tuples of any length. This is a motivated infinite-family classification, not an arbitrary slice or a mere small numerical increment.
